name: Hyoudou Mio
source:
[Original World]: She loves Yukito as her childhood friend. She thinks of their relationship as that of an older sister and a younger brother.
[Alternative World]: She wants to touch Yukito out of sexual curiosity. She has seen him as a little boy in her childhood.
translation:
[Original World]: She loves Yukito as her childhood friend. She thinks of their relationship as that of an older sister and a younger brother.
[Alternative World]: She wants to touch Yukito out of sexual curiosity. She has seen him as a little boy in her childhood.
